completeness.why: The new getRangeMidpoint covers only the range arithmetic; forecast, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions each keep their own null/number/range dispatch although the existing getScheduledAmount decides all three cases (partial). The budget template's hand copy (halving the rounded sum, dispatching on op) is untouched and not carried as an explicit variation (none).

interface.why: Adds a second, narrower exported helper (getRangeMidpoint) beside the existing getScheduledAmount instead of routing callers through it; the template's different rounding is not made explicit as a parameter and the missing/number cases stay at the call sites.

disguised_duplication.where: The four `== null ? 0 : typeof === 'number' ? v : midpoint` ternaries remain openly in forecast-schedules.ts, app.ts (x2) and shared/schedules.ts; they are left in place, not reshaped, and the template copy is unchanged.
